bio:
After completing work experience at The Pet Studio, Bea was invited to join the team as an apprentice. She is now developing her practical skills while learning from experienced groomers in a busy professional salon.

Bea loves being part of the team and values the opportunity to spend each day doing something she genuinely enjoys. She brings enthusiasm, creativity and a willingness to learn to her role. Outside work, she enjoys painting, swimming, snowboarding and spending time with her own dogs.
